cd /home/john/mynotes/shadow_frontier && python3 - <<'PY'
import numpy as np
new=np.load('results/phase_diagram_vhires.npz'); Ds,eps,TH=new['Ds'],new['eps'],new['TH'].astype(float)
old=np.load('results/phase_diagram_hires.npz'); oD,oe,oR=old['Ds'],old['eps'],old['RATE']/np.log(2)

# boundary eps*(D): largest eps with theta>=1 (region below boundary is allowed)
bnd=np.full(len(Ds),np.nan)
for di in range(len(Ds)):
    col=TH[:,di]
    if col[0]<1: bnd[di]=0.0; continue
    j=np.where(col>=1.0)[0]
    bnd[di]=eps[j[-1]] if len(j) else np.nan
# slope changes near half-integer / integer 2D
print("boundary eps*(D) near window-size jumps (2D integer):")
for Dq in [1.5,2.0,2.5,3.0,3.5,4.0]:
    di=int(np.argmin(abs(Ds-Dq)))
    sl_l=(bnd[di]-bnd[di-30])/(Ds[di]-Ds[di-30]); sl_r=(bnd[di+30]-bnd[di])/(Ds[di+30]-Ds[di])
    print(f"  D={Dq}: eps*={bnd[di]:.4f}  slope L={sl_l:.3f} R={sl_r:.3f}  jump={sl_r-sl_l:+.3f}")

# old vs new theta on the old grid (bilinear sample of new)
from scipy.interpolate import RegularGridInterpolator
I=RegularGridInterpolator((eps,Ds),TH)
pts=np.array([[e,d] for e in oe for d in np.clip(oD,Ds[0],Ds[-1])])
nv=I(pts).reshape(len(oe),len(oD))
diff=oR-nv
m=(oD>=1.0)&(oD<=1.7)
print(f"\nold(delta-grid) minus new(exact): overall max|d|={np.nanmax(abs(diff)):.4f}, "
      f"median|d|={np.nanmedian(abs(diff)):.4f}")
print(f"  in scallop zone D in [1,1.7]: max|d|={np.nanmax(abs(diff[:,m])):.4f}, "
      f"median|d|={np.nanmedian(abs(diff[:,m])):.4f}")
